Part of #27377 (wave 4, W4-MCP: the MCP live card, build + ask)

Selector `release-18.3.0-w4-mcp`: the five `ai.*` MCP items whose pins stop below the served door, driven live on real boots at the subject so every clause is scored at its own oracle layer (RUNNER rule 6). Part 2 of the card (18.3 MCP changes with no checklist item yet) is findings only and scores nothing; it is reported below and on the anchor. Every item has a verdict: **5 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN**. No item is `planned`.

## Environment fingerprint

- Subject: framework `7fa9873f38f7a0158e3ce17338dcc0f446b113e3` (detached, never followed main). Console built in-repo from the same commit: `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (117/117 tasks, 13m26s), then `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2` (71/72 cached, copy only).
- Node v22.23.4, pnpm 10.31.0, Playwright chromium from `/opt/pw-browsers` (consent-screen leg only).
- App: `examples/app-showcase`. Every boot `OS_PORT=PORT OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT=/tmp/w4mcp/RUN/uploads setsid pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:/tmp/w4mcp/RUN/data.db` (first boot compiled, later ones `--no-compile`). Sequential execution in one session; no subagents.
  - main 41520: MCP default-on, restarted twice on the same file DB (coded-refusals restart leg; the stdio leg borrowed the DB while it was down).
  - off 41521: `OS_MCP_SERVER_ENABLED=false`.
  - oauth (a) 41531 `OS_AUTH_URL=http://10.0.0.5:41531` — address NOT held by the host (it holds only 127.0.0.1 and 192.0.2.2; no `ip` tool to add one); (b) 41532 `OS_AUTH_URL=http://192.0.2.2:41532` (held, TEST-NET-1 = public to the rule); (b') 41533 = (b) plus `OS_ALLOW_INSECURE_OAUTH_HTTP=true`; (c) 41534 `OS_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:41534 --log-level info`; https 41535 `OS_AUTH_URL=https://10.0.0.5:41535 --cert/--key` (self-signed).
  - stdio: `node packages/cli/bin/run.js serve -p 41541 --dev` with `OS_MCP_STDIO_ENABLED=true OS_MCP_STDIO_API_KEY=osk_…` on the main DB, driven by the MCP SDK's stdio client.
  - Part 2 connector probes: a scratch copy of the showcase (removed after) on 41550/41551 with extra `provider: 'mcp'` instances against a local stub MCP server (127.0.0.1:47390: paged / endless / drift / hidden / 401 / 403 modes) and an `oauth2` instance against the main boot.
- Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai), demo persona auditor.demo@example.com; osk_ keys via `POST /api/v1/keys`; OAuth tokens minted on the embedded AS (DCR `application_type: native` → authorize with the MCP resource → consent → token, PKCE S256).
- Times: 2026-11-02 03:53Z to 04:14Z testing (wall), after 03:39Z–03:53Z environment.
- Cleanup: scratch app removed; `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/` absent; `git status` clean.

No defect on these doors.

## Part 2 — 18.3 MCP changes with no checklist item (findings only, no verdicts)

**build**
- HTTP `metadata:write` gate (#26464): a stock framework boot injects no authoring `ToolRegistry` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` passes no `authoring`). What a metadata:write grant IS served on a stock boot is the native federation pair from #27745, `list_remote_tables` + `import_object`; an osk_ key and a session bearer are served neither (held). **Finding:** every call of that pair under metadata:write, alone or with data:read / data:write, is refused 403 'Introspecting an external datasource requires the `manage_platform_settings` capability' for the platform admin; only a grant that also names actions:execute succeeds (extracted).
- stdio build door: the stdio server bridges `aiService.toolRegistry`, and the open framework registers no AI service, so a stock stdio boot lists the 9 data tools and no authoring tool. A draft authored through MCP end to end is not reachable on the open framework (cloud-host only); not driven.
- Draft provenance (#27176): `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.urgent?mode=draft&surface=mcp` → 400 VALIDATION_ERROR '?surface=mcp is not accepted over HTTP …' (copilot twin likewise); the same save with `surface=studio` → 200 and `?state=draft` reads `draftChanges:[{path:[],by:'studio',actor:…}]`. No in-framework door states `surface: 'mcp'` yet (the changeset says the build door starts in a later change), so the `by:'mcp'` + `client` stamp is not observable on a stock boot.
- Consent screen (#26587), Chromium on the built console, `/_console/oauth/consent` for scope 'data:read data:write actions:execute metadata:write': the metadata:write row reads "Build and change this app's metadata as drafts, within your own permissions — a person publishes them"; zh-CN reads 「以草稿形式构建和修改此应用的元数据（不超出您自己的权限），由人来发布」; openid / offline_access render as sentences. **Note (not filed):** the check icon on the long metadata:write row renders visibly smaller than the other three (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/OAuthConsentPage.tsx`, the `Check` icon has no `shrink-0`). It meets the reproduction and landing-point tests of the filing gate, but no user task or decision is affected by it, so the business reason does not stand and it stays a note here.
- `agent_prompt` agentName `build`: HTTP /mcp serves no `agent_prompt` at all (prompts there are skill projections). stdio lists `agent_prompt`, whose argument description says 'e.g. "ask", "build"', and answers `build`, `ask`, `metadata_assistant`, `data_chat` alike with a successful prompt whose text is 'Error: Agent "…" not found': an open-framework boot registers no agent (`GET /api/v1/meta/agent` → items []). Extracted for triage.

**ask**
- `agent_prompt` agentName `ask` and retired alias `data_chat`: as above, not found on stdio, absent on HTTP.
- Audit row for an MCP action (#27908): `sys_audit_log` (telemetry DB) gained one `action_invocation` row per invocation: auditor's refused MCP run `{surface:'mcp',branch:'update',outcome:'failed',status:403,error_code:'PERMISSION_DENIED'}`, admin osk_ run `{surface:'mcp',outcome:'succeeded'}`, REST control `{surface:'rest'}`, OAuth-token run adds `performed_by` = the client id, `on_behalf_of` = the admin id; an admission refusal (unknown action) wrote no row. Holds.

**connector-mcp**
- OAuth MCP server via the MCP authorization flow (#26702): an `oauth2`/`authorization_code` instance at `http://localhost:41520/api/v1/mcp` boots degraded "not connected"; `POST …/connection` without a fixed origin → 503 naming OS_BASE_URL (by design); with OS_BASE_URL it ran PRM → AS discovery → DCR on the upstream and answered an authorizationUrl (S256, resource indicator); consent on the upstream → callback 200 `status:connected`; the instance re-materialized `ready` with the upstream's 14 tools; a flow `connector_action` run_action through it left an upstream audit row with `performed_by` = the registered client and `on_behalf_of` = the upstream admin. DELETE connection → degraded "not connected", dispatch refused. The plain-http non-loopback twin is held degraded and its connect refused 400. Per-organization tokens across two organizations not driven (stock `single` posture holds one organization). **Finding:** the held instance's ERROR log line carries `{"error":"undefined"}` instead of the reason, and the refusal sentence ends in a double period (extracted).
- `tools/list` pagination (#26709): 6 tools over 3 cursor pages all became actions and a page-3 tool dispatched end to end; an endless cursor degrades with '…nextCursor after 100 pages …' and is retried. Upstream 401 / 403: the instance is degraded with 'was refused by its MCP server (HTTP 401|403) … This is a configuration fault — fix the credential.' and not retried; the boot does NOT fail — #27237 superseded #26709's "fails boot" wording (anchor accuracy line).
- `toolsSnapshot` (#27401): matching pins → ready; a drifted `d_moving` description → degraded `…toolsSnapshot does not match … tool 'd_moving' changed (it now hashes to a9c9…5376) … exposes none of the server's tools`; reverting the server recovered the instance on the backoff without a restart. A non-hex pin and a pin on a tool `include` leaves out each fail the boot with their own sentence.
- `include` refusals (#27402): `include: 'h_listed'` and `['h_listed', 7]` fail the boot ('must be an array of tool names (strings)'); `['h_listed','nope']` fails the boot naming 'nope' and listing the server's 'h_listed', 'h_other'. The credential-scoped twin (#28311, credential sent) not driven.

## Time: environment prep vs testing

- Environment: 03:39Z–03:53Z (14 min wall): install 28 s, `pnpm build` 13m26s, `console:build` 1 s; probe scripts and the stub server written while the build ran.
- Testing: 03:53Z–04:14Z (21 min wall): Part 1 ~11 min across 7 boots, Part 2 ~10 min across 11 boots (connector boot-fail cases ~12 s each).
- Ratio about 2 to 3. Session cost at report time about $4.
